thread:
nina_cs: FYI ClearHarbor renewal running into PO vs invoice entity mismatch. Procurement insists PO must match vendor code in our AP system. Kickoff scheduled Wed - want to avoid delaying onboarding.

leo_ae: Context: they agreed 250 seats for 12 months at +5% but their AP sent PO to our EU subsidiary name while contract is under Redwood US entity. They asked for Net45. PO# CH-9021.

billing_maya: We can invoice the EU entity only if they provide VAT registration + vendor code. Otherwise we can invoice US entity but procurement may reject the PO. There are withholding considerations if invoiced to wrong entity.

amina_legal: For Net45 we need a brief payment terms addendum and an explicit indemnity for withholding if invoiced to US. I can draft a short addendum. Prefer we get their VAT docs to avoid extra clauses.

sam_ops: Operational note: onboarding cohort fills quickly. If sign-off slips beyond Thursday we lose the Weds kickoff and next slot is two weeks out. Any ability to start with a provisional kickoff (no active seats) and enable after paperwork?

leo_ae: Procurement said they're willing to reissue PO if vendor code is updated, but that will take 24-48h. They asked if we can do a 6-month bridge at current price while they finish PO for 12m.

nina_cs: Bridge option might be OK to keep momentum. Is finance comfortable with a 6m interim term at full price and tag it as "bridge-term"?

billing_maya: Finance can accept a 6m bridge at listed rates if AE records it as a non-renewing interim term and we track the PO for the full 12m reissue. Need an explicit note in CRM.

amina_legal: I'll add a one-paragraph Delegated Billing Addendum that allows procurement to reference our US entity on the PO for this bridge term and conditions Net45 on receipt of VAT docs within 30 days.

docsign-bot: DocuSign envelope CH-0x9d12 created. Status: draft. Will send once addendum attached. Expiry default 7 days. Link: https://docusign.example/envelopes/CH-0x9d12

sam_ops: If we confirm bridge, I'll hold the Wed slot and prepare a trimmed kickoff agenda (core tasks only) so we can start onboarding work without license activation.

leo_ae: I'll tell procurement two paths: (A) reissue PO to match EU entity with VAT docs (fastest for full 12m) or (B) approve PO to reference US entity + sign bridge 6m addendum. Asking them now.

nina_cs: Action list: @leo_ae confirm procurement preference within 3 hours; @amina_legal draft addendum and attach to DocuSign; @billing_maya mark provisional invoice path and note withholding risk; @sam_ops block kickoff slot as tentative. I'll update ClearHarbor once we have procurement reply.

leo_ae: Update: procurement OK with option B to reference US entity for bridge, they will reissue full PO for 12m in 10 business days. Asking AP to email VAT docs but not required to start.

nina_cs: Great. Legal/billing - proceed with addendum and US invoice fallback. Sam - proceed holding Wed kickoff. I'll resend envelope once DocuSign has the addendum. :white_check_mark:

(ends)
